contestNote: Estimates range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP) — a 20x spread.

contestNote: New shallow aftershocks continue near the epicentral zone — M2.6–3.1 near Istmina on Aug 22–23, then seven more (M2.7–3.5) centered on Sipí, Andagoya and Istmina overnight into Aug 24 — though SGC has not published an updated running total since 325+ (Aug 17).
